newsitem.title: USA: Polaris stock plunges; personal watercraft sales off.
newsitem.headline: Polaris stock plunges; personal watercraft sales off.

text.p: The stock of Polaris Industries Inc. plunged Thursday after the company said its sales of personal watercraft had fallen by 8 percent in the eight months through August compared with a year ago.
Polaris, which also makes snowmobiles and all-terrain vehicles, was off $5 to $23.25 on the New York Stock Exchange in afternoon trading.
The Minneapolis-based company said that the selling season for the personal watercraft, which are one- or two-person runabouts, was virtually over and sales were down from the 1995 levels.
It also said that demand for the watercraft appeared to be leveling after several years of unusually high demand.
Polaris said it will cut its production for the 1997 model year to bring supply in line with next season's expected demand.
